editorial:
Imagine being a teenager and suddenly finding yourself in the middle of a brutal war with almost no training. That is exactly what happens to you in this movie. You follow a group of 71 student-soldiers who are left behind to guard the city of Pohang while the rest of the army retreats. The vibe is intense and scary because these kids aren't professional soldiers; they are just terrified students trying to survive. You will feel their panic and their bravery as they realize they are the only thing standing between the enemy and the city.

The action scenes are loud and exciting, and the acting makes you really care about whether these boys make it out alive. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the final battle makes up for it with lots of energy. If you enjoy stories about unlikely heroes, you should definitely give this a try. For the best experience, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the explosions, or you can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you love owning your movies.
endingExplained: In the final act, the students fight a desperate battle against the North Korean army. Most of the boys are killed in the heavy fighting, showing the true cost of war. The few survivors are eventually rescued by UN forces. The movie ends by telling you that this was based on a true story, leaving you with a heavy feeling as you realize how many young lives were lost to protect their home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves historical war movies and stories about courage.
